references.text: The place the Lord chooses for worship and joy for the entire household is a recurring theme in this chapter
The same command to eat the tithe at the place the Lord chooses, together with the whole household and the Levites
Joy before the Lord at the chosen place, including sons, daughters, servants, and Levites
The same list of people who are to rejoice before the Lord during the festival
Command to rejoice over all the good things the Lord has given, together with the Levite and the foreigner
The portion of the Levites and their dependence on the offerings of the people
Care for the Levite who has no inheritance or property among the Israelites
The Lord's blessing over all work and everything one undertakes
